note: Preview of the Town Hall 19 update (Nov 16, 2026) from the wiki's sneak-peek data, read Nov 14, 2026. TBA = not revealed yet. Values can change before release. Squads deploy a fixed group of troops with one tap, using less housing space than the same troops deployed one by one. Squad troops use your own troop levels. They're made at the Squad Barracks (Army Buildings, from TH 8). Supercell announced 12 squads; only two have been named so far. Source: Supercell's Clash On reveal (Nov 2026), via news coverage; the wiki has no squad pages yet.
